folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B281: P1 combat consumer receipt joined
folds.body:
The full [P1 status](gm/dispatch/deep-engine-2026-10-20/P1_STATUS.md) supplies the missing final pilot detail; the full [dispatch checkpoint](gm/dispatch/deep-engine-2026-10-20/CHECKPOINT.md) explicitly qualifies its original startup table. P1 reports a shared effective defender-input seam for damage_taken, min_damage_share and crit_resistance across B1 native duel, B2 redirected party ally, B3 causal strike and B4 feature battle, retaining each consumer's local body, stamina, consent, floor, cap and outcome policy. Actual Hero equip/remove and Enemy equipment-key/factory snapshots were exercised with synthetic inputs; this is narrower than every stat in every battle or a natural creature campaign.

Keep P1's source-only and provisional-registration browser cases separate. The provisional P2 item-factory handoff was required for explicit equipment-key enemies, and the later P2 receipt already reports it integrated. P1's own 42 focused passes and rebuilt 1920×1080 current-format persistence proof coexist with its 2,363/2,364 full-suite result and reproduced baseline Sinew multi-stack crafting failure. Later combined P2 results qualify that earlier failure; no fresh suite was run by this reconciliation. Natural equipped Direwolf access, ordinary acquisition/crafting, encounter cadence and human judgment were expressly not established by the synthetic cases. P1's accidental shared generated build was reported hash-restored with no net output change, not hidden or treated as a delivered bundle.

The old dispatch's actual five chat receipts establish creation/startup only; final releases come from the lane records. The historical 26–31% allowance, two concurrent lanes, sole-writer reservations and FF3 not-yet-present notice do not assign today's usage, writers or new work. Preserve them as dated coordination history. No chats, agents, runtime changes, commits or pushes are launched by this join.
